conclusion: No source-proven unavailable API or missing SDK guard found in the three reviewed files for Android 10-16. This is a source/API review, not device compatibility certification.
compatibility_observations: NativeProcessSession uses Os.stat/Os.kill (API 21), Process.isAlive/destroyForcibly (API 26), and java.nio.file directory enumeration (API 26), all below minSdk 29. The previously invalid Os.getpgid call is absent; group/session identity is parsed from /proc stat.

DownloadService startForeground(id, notification, type) was added in API 29 and is valid at this minimum. Manifest declares dataSync and both foreground service permissions; notification PendingIntents specify FLAG_IMMUTABLE.

onTimeout(int,int) is an API 35 callback override without a super call or an invocation on old devices. Merely declaring this override does not require a runtime guard. The handler cancels work and calls stopSelf, which is one of the documented timeout termination paths.
FileDigest uses ContentResolver asset-descriptor cancellation and streams through runInterruptible; no platform call above API 29 was identified.
limitations: No build, emulator, test device, installation, or publication was performed.

/proc permissions, kernel behavior and OEM process controls were not exercised. Denied identity reads fail closed; helper-environment access after leader death remains an explicitly acknowledged cleanup limitation, not a newly proven Android-version regression.
Native executable/binary ABI and 16 KB page-size compatibility on Android 15/16 cannot be established by these three Kotlin files; binary/runtime validation remains outside this review.
No source-proven background FGS start failure path was established from the inspected callers; generic platform restrictions are not reported as defects.
